name: fmp-dev-orchestrator
description: Selects the skill or tool for each Claris FileMaker task, with or without Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK): maps each task to the CadenceUX skill or ADK tool that owns it, gives the install line when it's missing, plans requests that span skills, and checks the stack is current. Works with cadenceux-developer-experience, which runs the work.
